results.title: SIPA’s Breakthrough GME 30.40 Neck Finish Cuts PET Weight by 29%
results.description: SIPA’s GME 30.40 neck finish has gained approval for nitrogen hot-fill production, offering beverage bottlers a lighter PET format and simpler component management. The post SIPA’s Breakthrough GME 30.40 Neck Finish Cuts PET Weight by 29% appeared first on Polyestertime .
